subject: Request: Starter fuel extension & promotional top-up for ScalarWorks

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starter fuel extension request & short promo top-up (ScalarWorks)

Hi Jasmine,

Hope you’re well — I’m writing from Foundry Accelerator on behalf of ScalarWorks (cohort 12). They’ve been running a 30-day trial with the Redwood hosted API and have hit 85% of the allocation in 18 days. Usage has exceeded their estimates because they spun up a guided demo flow and an automated eval suite.

Would Redwood be able to: 1) extend their trial window by 21 days, and 2) provide a one-time promotional top-up (we’re proposing an extra $5k in credits or equivalent token allotment) so they can finish the remaining evaluation milestones before Demo Day.

ScalarWorks is a promising ML-native startup focused on vector search for robotics; Sofia (cc’d) can share specifics. The program deadline is tight — if we can confirm before Friday it would unblock their Demo Day prep.

Attached: usage_report_2026-09.csv (shows token breakdown).

Thanks,
Elena Park

elena.park@foundryaccelerator.com

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding a Foundry ask for ScalarWorks. Quick summary: cohort startup needs a 21-day extension + ~$5k promo credit. They’ve already used most of the trial because of an automated eval run.

Questions for approval: 1) can we authorize a $5k top-up from program budget (partner promo), 2) any guardrails (expiration, one-time only, non-refundable), 3) should we require a short SOW addendum (I attached a suggested one: SOW_ScalarWorks_v2.pdf).

If we can approve quickly I’ll reply to Elena and include a DocuSign link for the SOW.

— Jasmine

Thanks for the flag, Jasmine. I'm comfortable approving an exception here given Foundry's relationship and the likelihood of ScalarWorks converting to Dedicated next quarter. Approve: 21-day extension + $5,000 promotional credit. Conditions:
- Credit expires 60 days after issuance if not consumed.
- Non-transferable and limited to the ScalarWorks account included in the SOW.
- No stacking with other promotional offers.

Please include standard SOW addendum and indicate that additional capacity or SLA guarantees will require a separate Dedicated commit. Karthik — can you confirm billing code for partner promos so we tag this properly?
